title: The echo buffer
description:
Model the driver side of an echo request with buffered I/O.

```
input "hello" (5 bytes), output buffer 16 -> output "hello", Information 5
input 20 bytes, output 8 -> STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL, Information 0
input 0 bytes -> STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
```
hints: `Information` too large is how a driver leaks kernel memory to user mode.
requirements: One system buffer holds the input, then the output.
Check both lengths before copying anything.
Set `Information` to the bytes returned, never more than the output length.
stretch: Upper-case the echoed text, so you can see the driver really did something.
